text:
Russia is the largest country in the world, but apparently, Aunt May’s cat has declared war on her knitting club’s supply chain.

The weekly "Stitch and Bitch" session took a chaotic turn when the feline culprit decided that unraveling a sweater wasn’t just a hobby, but a full-scale home renovation project. The result? A trail of woolly breadcrumbs stretching from the living room to the kitchen, so extensive that Hansel and Gretel would have been envious of the navigation aid.

It’s the ultimate relatable nightmare: you’re trying to maintain a semblance of adult sophistication while your pet turns your cozy hobby into a yarn-based crime scene. Next time, maybe hide the needles. Or the cat. Preferably both.
